label: Watch New Leads (Polling)
description: Polling trigger: checks GET /v1/leads on the scenario schedule and emits leads newer than the last run (after cursor). Use when a webhook trigger is not wanted.
output: New leads since the last poll.
notes: SKELETON — part of the Make custom-app spec (see integrations/make/app.json). Build this module in Make's web UI / VS Code from this spec; the endpoint (method + path) is the contract the module must call.
